title: The Painted Silk Lantern
scene: At 6:20 PM, the painted silk lantern vanished from the drying rack. The 6:00 PM harbor shuttle takes 30 minutes to reach Pine Point.

suspects.name: Gwen Sawyer
suspects.testimony: I mixed gold ink at the table right beside the drying rack from 6:05 to 6:25 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: Two festival volunteers watched Gwen mixing gold ink beside the rack from 6:05 to 6:25 PM.

suspects.name: Talia Okafor
suspects.testimony: I cut bamboo strips on the back porch from 6:00 to 6:25 PM and never stepped inside.
suspects.alibiProof: The neighbor next door chatted with Talia on the back porch from 6:00 to 6:25 PM.

suspects.name: Niels Lindholm
suspects.testimony: I sanded lantern frames in the courtyard from 6:00 to 6:30 PM, watching the dusk settle.
suspects.alibiProof: The delivery courier waved to Niels sanding frames in the courtyard at 6:10 and 6:25 PM.

suspects.name: Elias Donovan
suspects.testimony: I caught the 6:00 PM harbor shuttle and was already hanging banners at Pine Point by 6:15 PM.
suspects.contradiction: The 6:00 PM shuttle doesn't reach Pine Point until 6:30 PM, and the lantern was in Elias's trunk.
